medium: THE JAZZ IMPROVISATION TURNED A SIMPLE MELODY INTO A CONVERSATION BETWEEN INSTRUMENTS.
A PATIENT PERFORMER LET THE JAZZ IMPROVISATION BREATHE BEFORE RETURNING TO THE MAIN THEME.
THE JAZZ IMPROVISATION SOUNDED DIFFERENTLY EACH NIGHT BECAUSE THE ROOM CHANGED THE ENERGY.
A SINGLE PAUSE IN THE JAZZ IMPROVISATION MADE THE NEXT BEAT ARRIVE WITH EXTRA FORCE.
THE JAZZ IMPROVISATION CARRIED A MEMORY THAT THE LISTENER COULD NOT QUITE PUT INTO WORDS.
THE BAND BUILT THE JAZZ IMPROVISATION ONE LAYER AT A TIME UNTIL THE WHOLE STAGE WAS VIBRATING.
A YOUNG PLAYER HEARD THE JAZZ IMPROVISATION AND DECIDED TO LEARN THE INSTRUMENT.
THE JAZZ IMPROVISATION MOVED FROM A QUIET INTRODUCTION TO A BRILLIANT, UNEXPECTED FINISH.
